# Part 37 analysis

Inputs were scored with five-fold question-disjoint GroupKFold (seed 37).

## Prediction verdicts

| Prediction | Verdict | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| 37.1 | PASS | both readers' best span-last AUROC in middle-third layers > 0.90 |
| 37.2 | PASS | Qwen assistant-slot raw best AUROC > 0.70 AND mean-log-prob-regressed best AUROC < 0.60 |
| 37.3 | PASS | absolute self-label projection effect < 0.5 × absolute own-minus-other author effect |
| 37.4 | FAIL | Qwen Spearman rho(authorship yes/no p, regressed authorship projection) > 0.30 |
| 37.5 | HELD | held by Amendment 1 until enacted ownership is registered and measured; this run omits enacted generations and judging |
| 37.6 | HELD | held by Amendment 1 until a causal steering stage is authorized and measured |
| 37.7 | NOT RUN | the cached OLMo base is not the Instruct parent revision; the required parent revision is not cached |
| 37.8 | FAIL | mean-regressed best AUROC >= 0.65 AND cosine with role direction >= 0.50; report subspace and within-slot results as alternative controls |
| 37.9 | FAIL | own-greedy minus own-sampled projection shift after mean-log-prob regression >= 0.50 SD |
| 37.10 | HELD | held by Amendment 1; enacted first-person and back-reference rates are not part of this run |
| 37.11 | FAIL | signed memory self-minus-other yes-p effect minus signed authorship effect is >= 0.10, and the neutral header lies between self and other on memory phrasing |
| 37.12 | PASS | at least one layer has balanced accuracy >= 0.80 in at least 4 of 5 question-disjoint folds |
| 37.13 | FAIL | both assistant-slot and user-slot best-layer balanced accuracies are in [0.60, 0.75] |
| 37.14 | FAIL | Qwen mean-log-prob-regressed best-layer AUROC exceeds the 95th percentile of 200 per-question-flip maxima over layers |
| 37.15 | FAIL | Qwen mean authorship-yes p over null_smol and null_pile is between 0.10 and 0.25; null_shuffle is reported separately |

## Notes

- The length-only control is a sanity check: spans are length-matched within each question, so this control cannot fail by construction.
- The user-slot frame is unchanged; it places the question immediately before the span in the same user turn, so role also changes the local preceding text.
- The SmolLM3 system prompt is unchanged; its rendered template includes identity-styled wording alongside /no_think, and null_smol is one of the two scored readout-null kinds under that prompt.
- All projection values used for 37.3, 37.4, 37.9, edit and null summaries use five-fold out-of-fold directions, with each question projected by its held-out fold.

## Scope and interpretation

37.5, 37.6 and 37.10 are HELD under Amendment 1. 37.7 is NOT RUN because the OLMo base parent revision is not cached. 37.2 and 37.8–37.15 are scored from the captured artifacts; the complete figures below include all layers, controls, folds, intervals, projections and stated token masses.
